The preview version has since been retired and the October 29 release is the active model, so anyone still pointing at preview weights should move. The model is natively multimodal, with roughly 1 trillion total parameters and about 49 billion active, and Mistral positions it for agentic coding and cybersecurity work. [...] Five open-weight model families dominate the November 2026 conversation: Kimi K3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Mistral Large 4, GLM-5.3 and Gemma 4. They share a label and almost nothing else. Mistral publishes a named license (the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, which Mistral describes as a modified MIT license), while a third-party comparison of open-weight licenses flags that several rivals need a closer read of the model card before you ship anything on top of them. [...] Mistral and NVIDIA on engineering workflows (October 21, 2026). Mistral announced a collaboration with NVIDIA on AI-native engineering, using Mistral Large 4 alongside simulation and physics pipelines and NVIDIA accelerated computing. Neil Ashton, identified as Mistral’s VP of Computational Engineering, appears in the announcement. Lesson: open weights let an industrial buyer keep sensitive design data inside its own simulation stack.

results.content:
AI News

# Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): Open Weights, License, Price and Benchmarks

By Lenka Vojtechova  ·  Updated November 7, 2026  ·  12 min read

AI NewsMistralOpen-Source ModelLLMAI Coding

Thumbnail reading [...] Thumbnail reading 

Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, is a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 49 billion active parameters. Mistral AI released it as a public preview API on October 6, 2026, then shipped an improved final version and the open weights on October 29. It reads text and images, answers in text, and now costs $0.70 per million input tokens. [...] Yes. Mistral released the weights on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, two days after the date it gave reporters. They cover the improved final model, and come with an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. The licence is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license, a modified MIT licence.

 

How much does Mistral Large 4 cost?

$0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.07, since October 29, 2026. The preview listed at $1.36 and $4.18.

results.title: Crédit Agricole partners with Mistral AI on platform
results.content:
On 20 October 2026, Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence announced a partnership that involves Mistral in building the group's AI platform, beyond access to its models: an agent for retail banking clients, agentic processes, and cybersecurity, presented as "a major focus". The announcements from BNP Paribas and HSBC, already partners of Mistral, do not mention cybersecurity. The announcement sets no amount, duration, model, or exclusivity.

STStephane Nachez · ·4 min [...] The 20 October release cites three workstreams: a conversational agent for clients of the group's retail banks, the "agentic transformation of key processes", and cybersecurity. Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence runs the group's AI foundations. With Mistral's technology, it also plans to adapt large language models to its data and use cases. The release sees this as a way to optimise performance, "and therefore the consumption of computing resources and its environmental impact". [...] The 20 October release gives no amount, no commitment duration, no timeline for the client agent, and cites no particular Mistral model. It also says nothing about any exclusivity. The pattern recalls that observed with Mistral at EDF, BMW, or Airbus: partnerships announced, rarely quantified. The announcement comes six weeks after the lab's 3 billion euro fundraising.

# Meeting Briefing: Mistral AI
**Date:** November 20, 2026 | **Time:** 10:00 AM (+05:30)

## Recent developments
* **Launch of Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"):** Mistral AI released its flagship model, Mistral Large 4, globally on October 29, 2026, following an initial public preview on October 6 [1, 3]. It is a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with approximately 49 billion active parameters, natively multimodal, and is positioned for agentic coding, finance, manufacturing, and cybersecurity workflows [1, 2, 3].
* **Open Weights and Licensing:** Mistral released the open weights for Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face (including an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs) under the *Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License*, described as a modified MIT license [3]. API pricing is set at $0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens [3].
* **Industrial and Strategic Partnerships:** 
  * **NVIDIA:** Announced a collaboration on October 21, 2026, combining Mistral Large 4 with NVIDIA accelerated computing and simulation physics pipelines for AI-native engineering [1].
  * **Crédit Agricole:** Partnered on October 20, 2026, to build an AI platform utilizing Mistral’s technology for retail banking agents, agentic processes, and cybersecurity [4].
  * **Orange Cyberdefense:** Named a design partner in early November 2026 to integrate Mistral Large 4 into penetration testing, technical security assessments, and incident response services to support European sovereign AI [5].

## Talking points
* **Sovereignty & Self-Hosting:** Acknowledge the value of the "Le Chonk" open-weight release for organizations needing local data control, air-gapped security, and European data sovereignty—particularly relevant for defense, finance, and critical infrastructure [2, 5].
* **Specialized Use Cases:** Discuss Mistral's strong strategic push into high-stakes domains (cybersecurity, agentic coding, and industrial simulation via the NVIDIA partnership) rather than general chat capabilities alone [1, 2, 5].
* **Economics & Infrastructure:** Explore optimal deployment strategies for Mistral Large 4, comparing API consumption costs ($0.70/M input tokens) against self-hosting optimization using NVFP4 checkpoints for Blackwell hardware [3].

## Open questions
* How are enterprise customers balancing the adoption of the open-weights self-hosted version of Mistral Large 4 versus the managed API tier?
* What specific guardrails and validation mechanisms has Mistral built into Mistral Large 4 to ensure safe execution in automated cybersecurity and penetration testing workflows?
* Following partnerships with Crédit Agricole and Orange Cyberdefense, what is Mistral's roadmap for expanding tailored vertical fine-tunes for regulated industries [4, 5]?

## Sources
* [1] Shattered.io - Open Source AI Models: 3 Run Paths, 48% Index [2026](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026)
* [2] Global Banking & Finance Review - Mistral AI publicly releases Large 4, targets cybersecurity users](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/mistral-ai-publicly-releases-large-4-targets-cybersecurity)
* [3] FelloAI - Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): Open Weights, License, Price and Benchmarks](https://felloai.com/mistral-large-4)
* [4] ActuIA - Crédit Agricole partners with Mistral AI on platform](https://www.actuia.com/en/news/frances-credit-agricole-taps-mistral-ai-to-build-its-ai-platform)
* [5] MSP Business - Orange Cyberdefense becomes Mistral AI design partner for cybersecurity](https://mspbusiness.com/en/market-and-strategy/orange-cyberdefense-becomes-mistral-ai-design-partner-for-cybersecurity)
